sph_interpretive_translation: From the harvested crop, one who has not been paid wages shall take one-third as completion of rightful claim.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from labor and participation in creation
Causation is established through direct contribution to yield
Capacity-based responsibility aligns with actual engagement in productive process
Restoration occurs when unmet entitlement is fulfilled proportionally
Consciousness alignment results from honoring energetic exchange
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent contributes labor to production AND receives no compensation THEN entitled to one-third of produced value
IF entitlement remains unmet THEN automatic fulfillment triggers upon availability of yield
IF claimant demonstrates causal role THEN proportional share must be allocated without punitive review
IF resource becomes available THEN pending claims are resolved by fixed ratio distribution
supreme_court_application: In adjudication involving economic claims arising from unpaid labor or service, the threshold of responsibility lies in demonstrable causality. The court must recognize that authority stems from active participation in manifesting value. Distribution follows inherent equity encoded in dharma, bypassing punitive frameworks and restoring balance through proportional allocation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established via labor's direct causality in yield formation. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential unfolding from effort to outcome. Proportional responsibility assigns one-third due to unremunerated engagement. Non-punitive reality rule ensures entitlement fulfillment without blame or penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Automatically allocate one-third of yield to unpaid contributor upon harvest realization
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Recognize laborer’s causal integrity and authorize proportional access
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Ensure future participation is supported through systemic recognition
Integrity Reintegration Pathway: Align societal structures to honor all contributors transparently
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law. Dharma is restored. Reality operates without punishment. Consciousness stands as the ultimate adjudicator.
